_comment: MassHealth PT-1 (Prescription for Transportation, renamed 'Provider Request for Transportation' per TRN-33, 2017). Fields reconstructed from mass.gov bulletins and the online-submission how-to. The form itself (mass.gov/masshealth) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so exact field labels/order are NOT verified against the live form. See MISSING section. Values are filled by the planner into /plan pt1_prefill (docs/contracts.md). Synthetic patients only.
form_name: Provider Request for Transportation (formerly Prescription for Transportation)

source.vintage: TRN-33 rename 2017; service-animal field APB-218 2011; confirm against current live form

fields.label: Eligible for Transportation (member must be eligible to proceed)
fields.note: Named in the online how-to; submission blocked if not eligible.

fields.label: Member pickup / residence address
fields.note: 'authorized only for the addresses on the PT-1 form'; new request needed within 30 days of address change.

fields.label: Is the treating provider the same as the submitter?
Treating provider NPI
fields.note: Searched by NPI or last name + zip when treating provider differs.

fields.label: Member accompanied by a service animal?
Requested mode of transportation
fields.note: Mode options (e.g. livery, wheelchair van, taxi, public transit) not confirmed from live form.

fields.label: Medical necessity / reason for transportation
fields.note: A Medical Necessity Form (MNF) is referenced alongside PT-1 (TRN-31); relationship to PT-1 fields unconfirmed.

fields.label: Trip frequency / recurring need (e.g. 3x/week for dialysis)
fields.note: Recurrence capture on the form is unconfirmed; needed for dialysis.

MISSING_MANUAL_CHECK: Exact field labels, order, and which are mandatory: the live PT-1 form at mass.gov/masshealth returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch. A human must open the actual form (logged-in provider portal or the downloadable form) and confirm the schema. WHY MANUAL: the form is behind an anti-bot / auth wall I cannot fetch.
transport_mode enum values: not confirmed. A human must list the actual mode options the form offers.

Relationship between PT-1 and the separate Medical Necessity Form (MNF): TRN-31 references both; confirm which clinical/necessity fields live on PT-1 vs MNF. WHY MANUAL: requires reading current regs.
Whether recurring-trip frequency (dialysis 3x/week) is a PT-1 field or requires separate requests per date. FAQ implies per-location requests; confirm. WHY MANUAL: requires the live form + FAQ.
All fields marked verified:false are reconstructions, not confirmed labels. Do not present them as the authoritative form schema until verified.
